method: CPU execution of unchanged WebGLPrograms.getParameters and encoding helpers; only internal exports added. Renderer defaults evaluated from original assignments, no actual renderer/GPU. Snowball render-system preserves gammaOutput default; Elf Ski explicitly enables it. GLTF base-color encoding assignment is supplied from source review, not a loaded model.

cases.name: snowball
cases.outputFunction: vec4 linearToOutputTexel( vec4 value ) { return LinearToLinear( value ); }
cases.mapFunction: vec4 mapTexelToLinear( vec4 value ) { return sRGBToLinear( value ); }

cases.name: elfski
cases.outputFunction: vec4 linearToOutputTexel( vec4 value ) { return LinearToGamma( value, float( GAMMA_FACTOR ) ); }
cases.mapFunction: vec4 mapTexelToLinear( vec4 value ) { return sRGBToLinear( value ); }

limits: No GL compilation, pixels, filtering, lighting integration, actual renderer/context or async model-load comparison.
Confirms encoding selection only; other shader/render parity remains unfinished.
